title: الدُّعَاءُ بَعْدَ التَّشَهُّدِ الأَخِيرِ وَقَبْلَ السَّلَامِ

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
items.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wamin ʿadhābi jahannama, wamin fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāti, wamin sharri fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāl

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ المَأْثَمِ وَالمَغْرَمِ
items.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāli, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt. allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika mina l-maʾthami wa-l-maghram

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman ka-thīran, walā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā anta, fa ighfir lī maghfiratan min ʿindika wa irḥamnī, innaka anta l-ghafwru ar-raḥīm

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.en: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
items.tl: Allāhumma ighfir lī mā qaddamtu, wamā akhkhartu, wamā asrartu, wamā aʿlantu, wamā asraftu, wamā anta aʿlamu bihi minnī. anta l-muqaddimu, wa anta l-muʾakhkhiru lā ilāha illā ant

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.r: أبو داود 2/ 86 والنسائي 3/ 53 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 1/ 284
items.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.
items.tl: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa ḥusni ʿibdatik

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ العُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ القَبْرِ
items.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives “i.e. old age, being weak, incapable and in a state of fear”, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-bukhli, wa aʿwdhu bika mina l-jubni, wa aʿūdhu bika min an uradda ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnati ad-dunyā wa ʿadhābi l-qabr

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.r: أبو داود وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 328
items.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ القَصْدَ فِي الغِنَى وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَأْسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ القَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ العَيْشِ بَعْدَ المَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
items.r: النسائي 4/ 54، 55 وأحمد 4/ 364 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 281
items.en: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger. I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.
items.tl: Allāhumma bi-ʿilmika l-ghayba wa qudratika ʿalā l-khalqi aḥyinī mā ʿalimta l-ḥayāta khayran lī, wa tawaffanī idhā ʿalimta l-wafāta khayran lī, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khashyataka fī l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati, wa asʾaluka ka-limata l-ḥaqqi fī ar-riḍā wa-l-ghaḍabi, wa asʾaluka l-qaṣda fī l-ghinā wa-l-faqri, wa asʾaluka naʿīman lā yanfadu, wa asʾaluka qurrata ʿaynin lā tanqaṭiʿu, wa asʾaluka ar-riḍā baʿda l-qaḍāʾi, wa asʾaluka barda l-ʿayshi baʿda l-mawti, wa asʾaluka ladhdhata an-naẓari ilā wajhika, wa ash-shawqa ilā li-qʾika fī ghayri ḍarrāʾa muḍirratin, walā fitnatin muḍillatin, allāhumma zayyinā bi-zīnati l-ʾīmāni, wa ijʿalnā hudātan muhtadīn

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.r: أخرجه النسائي بلفظه 3/ 52 وأحمد 4/ 338 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 280
items.en: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka yā llāhu bi-annaka l-wāḥidu l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam ywlad, walam yakn lahu kufūan aḥadun, an taghfira lī dhunūbī innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، المَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.r: رواه أهل السنن وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329
items.en: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka biʾanna laka l-ḥamda lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, al-mannānu, yā badīʿa as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrāmi, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ
items.r: أبو داود 2/ 62 والتّرمذي 5/ 515 وابن ماجه 2/ 1267 وأحمد 5/ 360 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329 وصحيح التّرمذي 3/ 163
items.en: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him.
items.tl: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-annay ashhadu annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun lahu kufūan aḥad
